Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer purchase order for the FlipMotion mechanical animation toy.

customerName.description: Full name of the customer placing the order.

phone.description: Customer contact phone number for delivery updates.

shippingAddress.description: Full street address for physical delivery.

productName.description: Name of the ordered item ('Sifteo Cubes').

baseCubes.description: Number of cubes in the base kit (3).

extraCubes.description: Number of additional cubes chosen by the customer (>= 0).

basePrice.description: Base price of 3-cube kit in FCFA (15 000 FCFA).

extraCubePrice.description: Price per additional cube in FCFA (5 000 FCFA).

extraAmount.description: Cost of additional cubes in FCFA (extraCubes * 5 000).

totalAmount.description: Calculated total order amount in FCFA (basePrice + extraAmount).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the order was placed.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Collection storing customer orders for Sifteo Cubes with strict validation, protected from unauthorized access or modification.
